episode.title: Cariboo Signals - Indigenous Lands & Innovation
episode.description:
Riley and Casey explore technology and society in rural communities. Today's focus: Indigenous Lands & Innovation.

NEWS ROUNDUP: We break down [The Guardian Global Development] A rain festival with no rain: the Indian farmers bracing for a ‘super’ El Niño as monsoon arrives late and 🔓 [Williams Lake Tribune] 68th annual Williams Lake and District 4-H Show and Sale a go, plus 1 more stories, and explore what these developments mean for communities like ours.

RURAL CONNECTIONS: Deep dive on Indigenous Lands & Innovation Topics include: data sovereignty, AI, infrastructure, funding.

Hosts: Riley (Tech optimist with an engineering background) and Casey (Community-first skeptic of tech promises).

COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT: Williams Lake Indian Band
